name: Stirling PDF
summary: Private PDF tools for everyday document tasks.

catalog.description: Stirling PDF gives you a private toolbox for everyday document work: merge, split, compress, convert, OCR, sign, redact, and automate PDFs without uploading them to random websites.

features.title: Fix everyday PDF problems
features.body: Merge, split, compress, rotate, redact, sign, and convert documents from one private web app.

features.title: Keep sensitive files local
features.body: Run document tools on your own server instead of sending private files to third-party upload sites.

features.title: Automate repeat work
features.body: Use pipelines for repeatable document workflows when the same manual steps keep coming back.

complexity.label: Easy setup
complexity.description: No account, secret, or first-run configuration is needed before MOS starts the app.

resourceHint.label: Light resources
resourceHint.description: A good first app for testing the catalog because it runs as one straightforward web service.

privacy.summary: MOS configures the self-hosted server to process ordinary PDF tasks locally and disable known optional analytics.
notes: Persistent app data is kept in package-owned volumes.
User-invoked features such as trusted timestamping can contact an external service.
The assessment is configuration- and documentation-based; it does not prove complete network silence.

homepage.name: Stirling PDF
homepage.description: Work with PDFs without uploading documents elsewhere.
